standard_operator_overrides.converter: framework exact one-node override with serialized GE-IR outcome audit

standard_operator_overrides.reason: old receiver TorchAir converters raise NotImplementedError while newer lazy registries may already emit the same SoftplusV2 node; the GE result is authoritative and a nonzero framework call count remains a consistency gate

standard_operator_decompositions.replacement: Kc static StridedSliceV2 columns plus Pack and Transpose
standard_operator_decompositions.semantics: exact [B,T,C,Kc] state after each current verify row; accepted slot, GDR ABI and external OM ABI unchanged
standard_operator_decompositions.reason: receiver TorchAir registers aten.unfold.default with a NotImplementedError converter

standard_operator_decompositions.source: EOS truncation and strict-greedy acceptance prefixes in ExactAcceptCommitStateGraph
standard_operator_decompositions.replacement: two fixed-width INT32 Cumsum prefix scans plus supported boolean elementwise and Sum operations
standard_operator_decompositions.semantics: first scan retains the requested proposal prefix through the first valid EOS inclusive; second scan retains only rows before the first Target mismatch; committed tokens, selected state slot and external OM ABI unchanged
standard_operator_decompositions.reason: receiver TorchAir leaves aten.amin.default, aten.min.dim and aten.cumprod.default converters unimplemented while aten.cumsum.default lowers to GE Cumsum

compiler.dynamic_external_weight_mapping_gate: for every dynamic graph, identify the canonical TorchAir package by import identity rather than assuming types.ModuleType, replace captured parameter placeholders only by GraphDef Data.index == runtime input index, and never index GraphDef.op by the runtime ordinal; only an explicitly marked injected unit-test double may skip receiver internals; fail export if the receiver private ABI drifts, the indexed Data is absent/RefData, the conversion is not invoked, or converted/used counts differ; restore TorchAir immediately after each export, record per-graph manifest evidence, and make compile-om reject every dynamic non-PASS/missing/count-mismatched audit before starting ATC
compiler.custom_op_gate: validate and propagate AIR custom_op_audit before ATC
compiler.ge_operator_type_gate: lock receiver/TorchAir names to DynamicQuant, QuantBatchMatmulV4444, AdnRmsNorm, ChunkGatedDeltaRule, CacheUpdate, AdnFusedInferAttention and ScatterNdUpdate for the recompute graph; incremental verify substitutes GatedDeltaRuleMTP for ChunkGatedDeltaRule
compiler.ge_ir_node_audit: count both TorchAir dynamo.pbtxt op and type node fields; use the per-file maximum per GE type to avoid duplicate counting
compiler.gdr_prototype_gate: reject duplicate or legacy ChunkGatedDeltaRule prototypes from ASCEND_CUSTOM_OPP_PATH and LD_LIBRARY_PATH before checkpoint load
compiler.adn_attention_prototype_gate: require exactly one receiver AdnFusedInferAttention prototype in ASCEND_CUSTOM_OPP_PATH with the locked ABI and an Ascend310P prebuilt object/metadata pair before checkpoint load
compiler.soc_policy: exact 310P variant required; generic Ascend310P rejected

runtime.model_load: integrated runner uses aclmdlLoadFromFile; incremental runner uses aclmdlLoadFromFileWithMem with separate per-artifact weights and one serial shared workspace
runtime.model_memory_query: aclmdlQuerySize is recorded for the active integrated OM; qwen35_dflash_om_inspect sums weights and uses the maximum serial workspace across a proposed multi-OM set
runtime.memory: persistent pinned host/device buffers; integrated input device mirrors upload only changed contiguous ranges after the first call and target D2H is limited to the last K+1 rows required by every current scheduler read; the multi-OM runner (five-artifact baseline, four-artifact unified Target step, or four-artifact fused speculative step) uses one 64-byte-aligned prefill control carrier but uploads only the prefix through the last field consumed by each chunk, keeps the EOS tail process-resident, gives the unified topology one aligned process-resident INT32 zero-count view, accumulates contiguous Target feature slabs in one device arena, and downloads only compact scheduler-visible results
runtime.device_memory_allocation: normal-only remains the compiled rollback default; build-cpp can produce a separate huge-first exact candidate. Both runners report the compiled policy, which covers every explicit aclrtMalloc including integrated I/O, multi-OM weights, the shared serial workspace, state and carriers; changing the default requires same-source/same-OM forward-and-reverse physical Ascend310P 3+10 zero-mismatch, memory-headroom and median/p90 evidence
runtime.synchronization: the multi-OM runner queues every non-final 64-row prompt chunk without LM-head execution, compact D2H or host synchronization, executes the head-only graph once after the final chunk, and exposes two independent exact selectors: DFlash windows 2..8 queue budget-safe dependent verify transactions behind one host boundary, while coalesce-first-verify joins final prefill completion with the already-prepared first verify in one contiguous D2H and one barrier when max_new_tokens is greater than two
runtime.execution_io_evidence: runner JSON records each resident aclmdl model ID, actual/full-equivalent H2D and D2H bytes, base/count/proposal/full prefill-prefix routes, packed-control/decode/proposal copy counts, Draft verify feature input/full-equivalent/elided rows and fixed/prefix/pending routes, unified Target-step resident-zero bytes and bindings, fused physical executions and Draft-to-verify launches elided, extended-window direct Verify-output bindings/bytes and zero post-Verify staging D2D, role executions, one completion per full prompt, elided intermediate-prefill D2H/synchronizations, speculative transactions, decode synchronization windows, prefill/first-verify coalesced windows, slot-dependent padding and both classes of elided D2H/barrier; actual D2H calls plus both elided classes close by transaction while stream synchronization closes by host-visible window
runtime.incremental_profile_attribution: diagnostic profile 1+1 records a preallocated ordinal/model ID/physical-row trace and analyze-msprof requires complete op_summary coverage plus exact aclmdlExecuteAsync, aclrtMemcpyAsync, aclrtMemsetAsync and aclrtSynchronizeStream counts before attributing Task Duration to role/gear; fused-speculative-step remains one physical model ID and its internal Draft/verify work is separated only at operator granularity; formal unprofiled 3+10 evidence disables and empties this trace
runtime.incremental_performance_candidate: framework/abi/incremental-performance-v2.json is APPROVED_IN_IMPLEMENTATION_NOT_ACTIVE; exact device-state implementation is authorized, while activation still requires export/ATC/parity/memory and same-device latency gates
runtime.incremental_transaction_tail: ExactAcceptCommitStateGraph keeps a fixed 16-row external transaction ABI with device-side longest-prefix acceptance, EOS truncation, scalar state selection and compact output; the five-artifact baseline executes physical T=16 for logical K=1..15, the inactive unified candidate executes physical T=1 for ordinary decode and T=K+1 for verify before padding only the transaction carriers back to 16 rows, and the inactive fused candidate preserves the fixed T=16 verify inside one exact Draft-to-Target supergraph
runtime.incremental_target_step_topologies: split-prefill-head-five-resident-v1 retains separate target-decode1, draft-propose and target-verify-commit; split-prefill-head-four-resident-unified-target-step-v1 removes decode and requires one dynamic target-verify-commit OM with every exact T=1..16 gear; split-prefill-head-four-resident-fused-speculative-step-v1 retains static decode and replaces the separate Draft/verify pair with one exact dynamic-feature supergraph; all remain inactive until real AIR/ATC custom-node, zero-mismatch, memory-fit and unprofiled latency gates pass
runtime.incremental_fused_speculative_step: one exact fused-speculative-step OM composes the existing Draft proposal and fixed-T16 Target verify/accept modules without externalizing verify IDs; each physical execution retains one logical Draft count and one logical verify count, increments draft_to_verify_model_launches_elided once, keeps Target/Draft state device-resident, and requires same-device forward/reverse unprofiled 3+10 evidence before activation
runtime.incremental_target_step_zero_count: the unified topology initializes one aligned INT32 zero in the first full prefill-control upload and binds every T=1 dataset directly to it; T=2..16 datasets keep binding the mutable positive-K proposal carrier, so ordinary decode issues no mutable K=0 H2D and cannot force a later positive-K restore; this is a C++ buffer/view route only and does not change the AIR/OM graph ABI
runtime.incremental_state_reset_candidates: async-memset clears one Target/Draft input state set inside first-prefill timing; immutable-zero initializes one extra read-only state set at process startup and removes per-request state clears; both preserve the v2 OM ABI and require same-device memory/latency selection
runtime.incremental_prefill_completion: non-final prompt chunks keep Target state and contiguous feature slabs ordered on one stream without executing Draft; a pinned-host staging slot per maximum 64-row chunk prevents asynchronous H2D source reuse. The default separate policy completes final prefill before decode; the exact coalesce-first-verify candidate prepares K=min(max_draft,15,max_new_tokens-2), queues the first verify immediately, downloads both alternating compact slots in one contiguous D2H and synchronizes once, delaying first-token visibility and requiring physical 310P TTFT/model-total A/B before activation
runtime.incremental_prefill_control: one carrier with AscendCL-compliant 64-byte-aligned device subsegments keeps exactly one H2D per prompt chunk but uploads only the prefix through IDs/effective length, final-Draft total count, a changed positive proposal count, or a changed process-resident EOS table/count; the five-artifact slot is 896 bytes, while the unified slot is 960 bytes after its aligned resident zero-count segment; strict report counters close all four routes, every elided byte and every unified T=1 zero binding
runtime.incremental_prefill_head: target-prefill excludes lm_head and exports last_hidden; target-prefill-head owns only the moved QLinear/top1/EOS boundary and executes once per completed prompt, while report counters require one elision for every non-final chunk
runtime.incremental_decode_device_carrier: two compact result arenas ping-pong with Target state, and one runner binary exposes an exact same-ABI selector: one-token-h2d keeps only one-row compact results device-resident and uses pinned-host H2D after multi-token commits, while last-token-d2d keeps every last committed token device-resident, binds row zero directly and copies later rows by one 8-byte D2D into the aligned scalar; report counters close both routes, and only same-device unprofiled 3+10 zero-mismatch evidence may select the deployment default
runtime.incremental_dflash_sync_window: the same runner and unchanged AIR/OM tensor ABI expose dflash-sync-window 1..8; window 2 directly coalesces the two compact ping-pong slots, while windows 3..8 bind each 452-byte Verify compact output directly to one slot of a process-resident eight-slot 4096-byte staging arena before one contiguous D2H and one synchronization, eliminating the prior post-Verify compact D2D; later Draft/Decode plans consume the staged carrier in place; every Ki is derived after reserving each predecessor's worst-case Ki+1 commit, eight 4-byte pinned proposal-count slots preserve arbitrary asynchronous H2D source lifetime, host commit remains ordered and stops at first EOS, default stays 1, and only same-device forward/reverse unprofiled 3+10 median/p90 evidence may select a larger window
runtime.incremental_zero_accept_fallback: the same runner and unchanged AIR/OM tensor ABI expose disabled and request-target-only policies; the exact candidate records completed accepted_count=0 transactions, consumes every already-enqueued transaction in the synchronized window, then uses authoritative one-row Target for the remainder of that request, eliminating subsequent Draft plus Verify pairs; disabled remains the default until same-device forward/reverse unprofiled 3+10 low- and high-acceptance cases preserve zero token/EOS mismatch and show median/p90 benefit without regression
runtime.incremental_draft_feature_prefix: the separate Draft OM and fused speculative-step candidate expose verify feature N=1..16 and prompt N=64,128,... gears; fixed-16 remains the default rollback route, while committed-prefix binds accepted+1 leading rows after synchronization and each predecessor's K+1 causal upper bound for later unsynchronized transactions; only KV below logical_draft_cursor is authoritative, row counters and msprof trace attribution must close, and real-device zero-mismatch 3+10 evidence is required before promotion
runtime.incremental_verify_scalar_state_seed: per-linear-layer-jit-v1 keeps committed GDN state scalar at the target-verify-commit graph boundary, lets causal-conv consume scalar state directly, and seeds only the fixed 16-slot recurrent input immediately before each linear-attention layer; it preserves the GDR-MTP ABI and requires regenerated AIR/OM workspace and latency evidence
runtime.incremental_verify_cache_indices: once-per-verify-v1 derives the 16 target-block and in-block-offset values once from the logical cursor and reuses them across K/V in all eight full-attention layers; the exact source graph removes 510 repeated div/remainder and 510 repeated cast constructions while retaining all 256 single-row CacheUpdate nodes until batched update receives separate approval
runtime.incremental_device_suballocation: control, compact-result and Target/Draft state arenas reserve ALIGN_UP(payload,32)+32 bytes per segment and begin every segment at a 64-byte-aligned address
